name: RoadGuard Head-Nod Prototype
tagline: Experimental head nod alerts and GPS speed
description: Standalone G2 research prototype: parked-only head-motion calibration, experimental monitoring for repeated head-nod-like motions, a static warning to stop safely and rest, GPS speed, self-report fatigue check, and break timer. Cannot determine whether a driver is awake; no flashing alarms. May miss drowsiness or issue false alarms. Not a certified driving-safety system. Do not use as a substitute for rest.
author: RoadGuard prototype team

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Reads phone GPS speed and optional heading for the simple speed display and detects when the car is stationary.
